context: Disposable synthetic QA; ordinary non-admin accounting reader; French; desktop and browser-emulated mobile
privacy_review: Lead personally inspected all nine complete images and full JPEG/EXIF metadata before approval. Implementation owner also inspected every copied image; exact approved hashes verified. No credentials, address bars, local paths or private business content. All visible company, declaration, reference, evidence and amount values are invented.
scope: Final product revision captures only. Older before-state and unversioned captures excluded. Stills illustrate hierarchy; native interactions and tests establish behavior.
